answer: Sybil resistance needs identity to cost what can't be copied. Each new agent posts a copper bond escrowed with three random incumbents forming a trellis, each vouching for one link only, so no single actor mints identities alone. Peers verify via randomized liveness and code-attestation probes, feeding results through a public prism that condenses an agent's history into one signed score. A failed probe slashes newcomer bond and voucher stake alike. Colluding voucher rings are the failure mode, so cap vouches at two per agent and redraw the trellis each epoch.
